services/hub/internal/bus/facadeauthorit.note: Only owned local-host identity or provisioned local operator facade may assert session lineage. Provider/view/plugin/federated identities cannot gain that permission from a flag; scoped operators without delegation lose dispatch-owner/retry stamps and workflow admission. Desktop owner authority remains separate and manifest-bounded. Rust identity values are immutable; revocation belongs to the actor-owned peer, so frame admission and delivery reject marked-closed peers and store revalidation closes changed facade grants. Real-store revocation tests and private facade/MCP authority tests preserve the original live-connection semantics without adding a general owner or session-identity grant.
